messages:
Alex G.: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / samplekit tiny-qa
Alex G.: What I did: updated Python SDK quickstart to include async streaming example, added Node ESM note, and created samplekit tiny-qa (minimal QA demo) that shows prefix caching.
Alex G.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 — main things: async example, a short troubleshooting section for macOS wheels, and a small README for tiny-qa.
Alex G.: Blockers: CI flake on macOS wheel build; E2E for tiny-qa failing against latest hosted endpoint (model change), and need a quick docs copy edit for the Node snippet wording.
Alex G.: Today: address CI fix with tox env tweak, pin tiny-qa to redwood/base-v0.8 for E2E, and follow up on Node wording after @Sam K. reviews. @Sam K. @Taylor R. can you take a look at the PR when you have a minute? :eyes:

Sam K.: Thanks — taking a look now. Quick nit: the Python streaming snippet uses `with client.stream(...)` but our v1 SDK uses `async with client.stream(...):` — small consistency issue.
Sam K.: Left an inline comment on the PR about the snippet and the README copy.
Sam K.: Also, can we add a one-liner about `timeout` behavior in streaming? Some users hit long-running streams and expect a default TTL.

Taylor R.: On CI flakes — saw failures on macOS wheel in the build matrix. Root cause looks like the build cache using an older wheel on mac-host-1; I'm adding a cache-bust in the CI job and rebuilding.
Taylor R.: Will push a fix in ~30m and re-run the macOS job. If that doesn't clear it, I'll isolate by installing from source in the job.

Maria P.: Tiny-qa E2E fails because the hosted catalog rotated default model to base-v1. The sample expects base-v0.8 prompt tokens. I pinned the infra config to `redwood/base-v0.8` in the tiny-qa test deploy branch: https://infra.redwood-inference.internal/deploys/3921 — deploy-bot pinged for a redeploy.
Maria P.: If we want to keep using base-v1, we should update prompt examples and token expectations; easier short-term to pin.

deploy-bot: deploy requested — tiny-qa -> staging (branch: feature/tiny-qa-pin). Status: queued. Estimated start: 5m. :rocket:

ci-bot: CI summary for feature/quickstart-async — 5 checks, 4 passed, 1 flaky macOS wheel failure. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/54822
ci-bot: Test failures are in `tests/test_wheels.py::test_macos_wheel_import`

Jen L.: Re: Node ESM snippet — I hit an import error on Node 18 when following the quickstart. The fix I used was `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference/node-esm';` and then `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });`
Jen L.: Can someone add that exact import line as an alternative to `require(...)` so users on Node 18/20 don't get confused?

Alex G.: Good catch, Jen. I'll add the explicit Node import and short note about Node versions. Also adding a one-line about `timeout` per Sam's suggestion.
Alex G.: Plan: (1) merge CI cache-bust fix from Taylor, (2) redeploy tiny-qa pinned branch via Maria's deploy, (3) update PR with Node import and timeout example, (4) request final review.

Sam K.: I'll re-check the PR after the CI passes. If tiny-qa tests pass on staging, we can merge and roll the samples copy to the samplekit site.
Sam K.: Left a :thumbsup: reaction on your inline fix proposal.

Taylor R.: Pushed CI cache-bust commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/commit/7f3a2d1 — kicked macOS job, currently running.
Taylor R.: If it still flakes, I'll force an isolated wheel build and upload for reproducibility.

Maria P.: Staging deploy started — tiny-qa pinned branch deploying now. Will post staging URL when ready.
Maria P.: Staging URL: https://staging.samples.redwood-inference.internal/tiny-qa — tests running.

ci-bot: macOS job retried — now green. All checks passed on feature/quickstart-async except one warning (doc lint: line-length): https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/54829

Alex G.: Awesome, thanks team. I'll update the PR with Node import, `timeout` snippet, and README note about model pinning. After that I'll ping for a final quick review.

Sam K.: Sounds good. I'm around for quick review after the PR update. :+1:

Alex G.: Final note: adding a tiny entry to the release notes under "Docs / DevEx" about the async quickstart and tiny-qa sample. Nothing blocking for the release schedule.
Alex G.: End of update.
